pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and sub-ovoid dark regions with smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. The patches show a decrease in spatial area from the central flank towards the neck and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream negative space forming 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. The pathways maintain a relatively uniform pixel thickness across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the neck and upper shoulder, indicating a continuous mane against the background.
